videos.headline: Highlight: Holloway, Dioubate lead No. 4 Bama to win vs. LSU
videos.description: Aden Holloway leads the Crimson Tide offense with 19 points while Mouhamed Dioubate scores 14 of his own to secure a hard-fought 80-73 victory against the Tigers.

videos.headline: No. 4 Bama's Holloway emphasizes importance of 'staying ready'
videos.description: Aden Holloway credits the Crimson Tide defense for their role in the 80-73 win over LSU and expresses the importance of playing with urgency from start to finish.
